boundary: Owner: spur line, tap valve station, remotely operable isolation valve and monolithic insulating joint; scope break at the downstream flange of the insulating joint. Contractor: counter-flange, gasket, stud bolts and everything downstream (gas receiving and metering station, SC-028). The Owner's cathodic protection ends at the insulating joint; plant earthing starts downstream.
connection: ASME B16.5 CL600 RF weld-neck flange, 16 in
contractor_side: Gas receiving and metering station from the inlet flange
isolation: Owner boundary isolation valve (operated by the network operator); Contractor station inlet ESD valve.
location_text: North-east plot corner, flange at EL +14.0
metering: Fiscal metering by the Contractor in the station, approved by the network operator (ER-18.03).
operating_conditions: Normal 55-65 barg; minimum 45 barg for full load; exceptional 40 barg up to 72 h/year (GT load limited, ER-03.03); MOP 70 / MAOP 75 barg; 5-25 degC; 115,000 Sm3/h firm (density 0.7325 kg/Sm3 at 15 degC, reference gas).
owner_side: 16-inch spur line (4.5 km), tap valve station, isolation valve and insulating joint
protection: Owner pipeline MAOP 75 barg; the Contractor's station is designed for 75 barg up to the regulators.
